evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To our knowledge, we present the first systematic zero-shot benchmark of unified multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for both assessing water-induced distortions and restoring shallow-water imagery within the same model framework.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate four assessment prompts (P0-P3), from direct instruction to structured task decomposition, on all 1,000 images and four diagnosis-guided restoration prompts (R0-R3) on a common 100-image subset.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Assessment varies substantially by model and prompt, with systematic prediction biases and a best pooled balanced accuracy of 0.654 for distortion presence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Two restoration-only baselines also show limited transfer: InstructIR achieves a pooled PSNR gain of +0.040 dB, while PromptFix degrades all four pooled metrics under every prompt.
